title: Prepare unconsumed bound sources
summary: Before a stage first consumes a bound project, the driver may refresh a stale pin to the declared branch head, record its from/to rebindings and rederive newly carried work through existing admission rules. Existing member facts and requirement snapshots stay fixed. consumed_by and consumed_at are recorded before dispatch. Re-driving a stage the same run already dispatched reattaches with its sealed inputs however the branch moved; any other dispatch on a moved consumed source, including a retry run, requires a new run. Source walks precede locks; changed preparation state refuses a same-run retry. Missing or unreadable evidence never authorizes dispatch.
verification: The public bound-sources procedure is the direct function home. Source teaching observed; no source pin, deployment membership, stage or run was changed or proved live.
